crossRefs.note: If you are righteous, what do you give him? Or what does he receive from your hand?
Who has first given to me, that I should repay him? Everything under the heavens is mine.
Isn’t it lawful for me to do what I want to with what I own? Or is your eye evil, because I am good?’
For who makes you different? And what do you have that you didn’t receive? But if you did receive it, why do you boast…

translations.web: “Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?”
translations.bsb: “Who has first given to God, that God should repay him?”
translations.kjv: Or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?
translations.asv: or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?
